clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 1 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 1 lakh over the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: OEM Average Turnover
clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 4 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 4 lakh over the last three years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder needs three years of past experience in the same or similar category.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete / Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs and startups get complete relaxation from turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover
clauses.summary: Sellers must submit experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorization and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail V /Required No /ePBG Detail V /Required No
clauses.summary: No EMD is required for this bid.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from experience criteria provided they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from bidder turnover criteria provided they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: An MSE bidder that is itself the OEM is relaxed from the OEM average turnover criterion.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from experience criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from bidder turnover criteria subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is DPIIT Registered OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: A DPIIT-registered startup OEM is relaxed from the OEM average turnover criterion.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate showing turnover.

clauses.quote: In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3-year-old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria.
clauses.summary: For bidders under three years old, average turnover of completed financial years since incorporation is considered.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government organisations or PSUs for the stated number of years.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted for each financial year of experience.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid document over the last three years.

clauses.heading: 10. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 80% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied at least 80% of the bid quantity to government bodies in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 10. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts proving cumulative supply quantity in one financial year must be submitted for past performance.
